question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off `mirrorWebchatToLastExternalChannel` session policy now, fold this workflow into the broader origin-channel delivery design, or keep WebChat isolated from external routes?
rationale: The requested behavior intentionally copies Control UI output into a previous external conversation selected from stored route state, so product intent and privacy boundaries must be chosen before implementation.

options.title: Add Explicit Opt-In Mirroring
options.body: Create a default-off session policy for WebChat-to-last-external mirroring with security, freshness, duplicate, failure, docs, and live proof requirements.

options.title: Fold Into Origin-Channel Policy
options.body: Keep this issue as the WebChat scenario while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54531 decides the broader durable origin/fallback delivery model.

options.title: Keep WebChat Isolated
options.body: Document explicit sends or channel-native replies as the supported bridge and avoid automatic WebChat-to-external mirroring.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Opt-In Mirroring
recommendation.body: Create a default-off session policy for WebChat-to-last-external mirroring with security, freshness, duplicate, failure, docs, and live proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to this issue and has the strongest current evidence trail on the relevant WebChat route guards and route-safety commits.
